utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: There you go. And then this one you have to go— that's where you're going to have to, because I have long hands. Then you can go like that, and then I go with my other hand because you're going to go down one, but you're going to skip that one.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Okay. Wait, Grandma, look at this app on my iPad. It says the finger positioning for this jazz chord is different. See the little blue dots on the screen?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Blue dots? I can't see anything with that glare, honey. And why are you looking at a piece of glass to learn music? Music is in the fingers and the ears, not in a television you hold in your lap.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: It’s not a TV! It’s a diagram. It shows exactly which notes to hit. Hold on, the screen timed out... let me put my passcode in. One second.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: We're sitting here waiting on a code while the piano is sitting right here ready to be played. Put that thing on the floor. I’m trying to show you the movement, not a picture of it. Let me know when you're finished with your gadget.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: And then skip one. Okay, let's see if you can do it. You did it!

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: No, this one will have to go here.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Okay, so you were here. Bzzz, bzzz, bzzz.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: No, no, no. Go back there and then you're going to go this way. Now come back up. There you go! This one only stays for a minute. Then you skip one and you just go down one here. Okay, let's try it. No, right here. The G and the F. You'll see. One goes here. Remember what we do? We're gonna switch. There you go!

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Come back up one at a time. That's right. Skip on the right.

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: There you go. Go ahead, you did it. You can just keep doing that forever.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Okay, Ruby, go on to the next one. Skip one here.
